tickets.method: Every ticket id from 1 to 300 was looked up one by one (list, archive and ticket endpoints); probing went on to id 500 and stopped after 200 ids in a row that do not exist.
tickets.detail: Freshdesk search reports 299 tickets outside the archive; 299 were found.

contacts.method: Freshdesk contact filter totals (active:true plus active:false) compared with the contact list.
contacts.detail: Freshdesk reports 120 contacts; the contact list returned 120.

saved_replies.method: The sum of responses_count over the canned response folders, compared with the canned responses listed in them.
saved_replies.detail: Freshdesk folders report 3 canned responses; 3 were listed.

knowledge_base.method: Freshdesk's articles_count of every folder compared with the articles listed in it, and its sub_folders_count with the subfolders listed; categories and folders directly in a category are listed only (Freshdesk reports no count for them); translations are the languages of /settings/helpdesk, listed folder by folder.
knowledge_base.detail: 0 categories and 0 folders listed; every folder count matched its list (0 articles, 0 translations in 0 language(s)).

warnings.message: Freshdesk agent has no Colliedesk agent with the same email; their replies keep the author name only. Invite them, then re-run to keep future items linked.
Freshdesk contact has no email; Colliedesk gave it a reserved .invalid address.
Freshdesk company has no contacts, so its name is not kept anywhere in Colliedesk.

This canned response holds a Freshdesk placeholder that Colliedesk has no variable for. It stays in the text as written; edit the saved reply before using it. The names are in saved_replies.unmapped_placeholders.
This Freshdesk folder is personal, so its canned responses were not imported. Run again with --include-personal-canned-responses to share them with the workspace.
Freshdesk documents no time entry endpoint for archived tickets; check them in Freshdesk before closing the account.

not_imported: Custom ticket fields and custom contact fields
Ticket group, product, company link, email_config_id, escalation flags, watchers, parent/child and merge links
Contact phone numbers, other emails, addresses, job titles and social handles
Companies other than their name (domains, notes, custom fields)
Message structured_body, support_email, notified_to and edit history (last_edited_*)
Files attached to canned responses (saved replies hold text only; the report lists the canned responses that had files)

Knowledge base: article translations are stored and exported but not shown in Colliedesk yet; translated category and folder names are not imported; tags, SEO data, views and votes are kept only in the article's source_meta
Files attached to knowledge base articles (the Freshdesk docs list none; if the API sends them, the report lists the articles)

Knowledge base markup Markdown cannot hold (iframes and video other than YouTube and Vimeo players, forms, scripts): left out of the article and listed; the original HTML is kept with the article and in the export
Images in message HTML that are not hosted by Freshdesk (other sites, tracking pixels) stay links; the original HTML is kept
Tickets in Freshdesk Trash or Spam (listed by id in this report)
Time entries of archived tickets (the Freshdesk API documents no endpoint for them)
A re-run takes subject, status, priority and assignee from Freshdesk again and only adds tags; tags removed in Freshdesk stay
